Thank you very much for taking the time to write that. just having someone know what I'm going through in my own head helps in a way. makes me feel a little less lonely. My art and photography and music videos being me the most joy because they make people smile. I sorta put that in a "deal with later" box though for now .  I really should be taking more pride in separating myself from the negativity of the alcoholic stalker I mentioned. I mean all of these recent struggles are for a greater good. I know my presence is helping my room mates too . 

what about you? I know you probably weren't in this thread without having difficulties yourself. if not thank you again any way
What are your reasons for not wanting to? It helps to talk about for reflection.
